name: Govee
author: Joel
description: Control your Govee lights, plugs, and appliances from the Omarchy bar using your Govee API key.

barWidget.description: Turn Govee devices on and off, set brightness, color, color temperature, modes, and scenes.

schema.label: Refresh in the background
schema.description: Poll the Govee cloud while the panel is closed so the bar icon reflects whether any device is on. Each refresh uses one request per device against Govee's daily limit.
